incident-bot: [ALERT] 3567890123 - routing:unexpected-variant-redispatch triggered for prod/eu-west-1 · Severity: P1
incident-bot: ... auto-escalating to on-call, paging kevin (rotation: infra)

sophia: saw the page, joining. any customer impact noted?

kevin: I'm up. logs show a spike of requests being routed to model:small-quant_v2 instead of model:opt-8bit. latency dropped but outputs are noisy. Possibly schema change in last deploy? Paging marta for config context. @marta

marta: I pushed the config change earlier to the routing schema to remove deprecated field "preferred_variant" per RFC-2026. It had a migration that set defaultVariant = "auto". I thought this would be no-op.

raj: hmm that matches. We have a migration script that maps deprecated preferred_variant -> defaultVariant but leaves unspecified as "auto" which resolves to lowest-cost variant in region.

kevin: customers in EU (acme-corp, beta-3) reported hallucinations on generated billing summaries. acme-corp support ticket escalated.

sophia: start mitigation: manually pin routes for affected customers to model:opt-8bit in eu-west-1. raj can you apply a per-customer override? I'm going to open a temporary routing block.

raj: applying override now for acme-corp & beta-3. CLI:

``
redwoodctl routes set --customer acme-corp --region eu-west-1 --model model:opt-8bit --scope pin
redwoodctl routes set --customer beta-3 --region eu-west-1 --model model:opt-8bit --scope pin
```

raj: overrides applied. Confirming traffic now flows to opt-8bit.

ops-bot: route-change: overrides applied by raj at 3567890150. Rolling update started.

kevin: seeing immediate drop in hallucination errors in logs. latency back to expected. :thumbsup:

marta: digging into the schema change — the migration removed preferred_variant and added default_variant with enum [auto, p99, cost_opt]. The default was set to "auto". Our routing resolver treats "auto" as cost_opt when variant is ambiguous, causing the cheap variant selection.

sophia: that's the surprise default behavior. we need a hotfix: migration should set default_variant to previous behavior (p99) for customers without explicit pin. Who can push a roll back? @alex

alex: I can draft a hotfix and a migration reversal to run quickly. plan:
1) backfill customers created before change to have default_variant="p99"
2) change migration to set default_variant="p99"
3) deploy and monitor

kevin: can we avoid a full migration by adding a compatibility layer in the resolver to treat missing default_variant as p99 for now?

marta: yes we can short-circuit in resolver. I'll patch in prod with a feature flag.

marta: deploying resolver patch behind flag at 3567890199.

ops-bot: deploy accepted. canary started on 5% of routing controllers.

kevin: canary looks good. no routing oscillation observed.

sophia: start coordinated communication: ops -> support -> customer success. kevin, please draft a short incident note for acme-corp. I'll handle internal postmortem framing.

kevin: draft: "We observed a routing config migration that changed the default routing behavior in eu-west-1 causing a small subset of requests to be routed to a cost-optimized model variant. We applied per-customer overrides and deployed a resolver patch to restore previous default behavior. We're continuing a full rollout of the fix and will follow up with root cause and permanent remediation." Thoughts?

sophia: good. add apology and offer to replay impacted requests if needed.

kevin: added. sending to support now.

ops-bot: postmortem task created: PM-8763, assign:sophia, due: +3d

sophia: summary of mitigations: 1) per-customer pins applied 2) resolver compatibility patch 3) migration rollback draft started 4) customer comms sent. We will schedule a full bake and test for migration scripts.

raj: follow-up checklist: add unit tests for migration, add explicit migration default in schema docs, add monitoring alert for variant distribution shifts (new metric: routing.variant_share).

marta: can we also add an automated canary check to verify that default migration doesn't flip variants for customers with no explicit config? add to deploy gating.

alex: acknowledged. I'll coordinate the rollback and postmortem.

sophia: closing the pager for now. kevin, if anything else spikes reopen. thanks team :heart:

incident-bot: Incident 3567890123 marked RESOLVED by sophia at 3567890289
